title: Spanish Pork and Potato Stew
summary: A hearty Spanish-style stew with tender pork, potatoes, peppers and a warm smoky paprika broth. It’s rustic, filling and ideal for a comforting dinner.

ingredients.name: potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Season the pork with a little salt and pepper, then brown it in batches until well coloured all over. Remove and set aside.
Add the onion and red bell pepper to the pot and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until softened and starting to turn golden. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Stir in the smoked paprika, dried thyme and bay leaves, then add the canned tomatoes. Cook for 2 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the pork to the pot and add the water and salt. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook gently for 35 minutes.
Add the potato chunks and continue simmering, covered, for 25 to 30 minutes, until the pork is tender and the potatoes are cooked through.
Remove the bay leaves, taste and adjust the seasoning with more salt or pepper if needed. Stir through the parsley and serve hot.
